dedupe_keys.name: geo tide trucking geospatial layer workflow

description: Geo-TIDE backend prepares geospatial layers for a trucking-industry decarbonisation explorer. Its repository describes combining public Freight Analysis Framework version 5 data with other mapped sources to show fleets and alternative energy-carrier options. Users run the documented processing workflow for a geography and source release; outputs are synthesised layers for the separate Geo-TIDE viewer. Geographic coverage follows the US freight data and areas selected by the project. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for this backend code. A limitation is that source freight volumes, route geometry and charging or refuelling assumptions can change independently; a visual layer is not an optimised fleet transition plan. Some processing steps reference companion repositories and should be checked before reproduction. The workflow can prepare logistics demand and corridor context for freight or energy-infrastructure simulation. The related catalogue AequilibraE model is a separate traffic assignment package. No FAF files or derived layers were downloaded.
